To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the expression of endothelin 2, endothelin-B receptor and endothelin-B2 receptors in the neural crest derivatives, enteric nervous system, and melanocytes is consistent with a role of endothelin 1 in their development.
endothelin 2 is expressed by neural crest derived cells and endothelin 3 by neural crest derived and neural crest independent cells.
endothelin 2 and endothelin 3 are expressed by neural crest derived enteric nervous system, and endothelin 2, endothelin 3 and endothelin-B receptor by neural crest derived melanocytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression pattern of endothelins in avian embryos.
the expression pattern of endothelins, their receptors and their ligand.
the role of endothelin 2 in the avian neural crest development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in the avian embryos, endothelin 3 and endothelin-B receptor are co-expressed, but the expression pattern of these genes is not identical.

endothelin 2 and endothelin 3 are coexpressed by neural crest-derived cells and their environment, and that endothelin 1 is expressed in the environment of neural crest-derived cells, but not in these cells themselves.
the expression pattern of endothelins and their receptor is a prerequisite to understand the development of neural crest derived cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the endothelin-B receptor and its ligand endothelin 3 are expressed by the neural crest-derived cells, and the other endothelin receptors are expressed by the environment.
endothelin 1, 2 and 3 are expressed by neural crest cells and endothelin-B receptor is expressed by the neural crest derived cells.

the endothelin-B receptor is expressed in the precursors of enteric nervous systems and melanocytes and endothelin 3 expressed in the environment of the precursors of these two neural crest derivatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
endothelin 1, endothelin 3 and endothelin-B2 receptors are all expressed by neural crest derivatives.
the endothelin 1/endothelin-A receptor pathway is not the only pathway for neural crest cell migration.
the endothelin 1/endothelin 3/endothelin-B2 receptor signaling is a paracrine signal for the development of enteric nervous systems and melanocytes.
